excerpt: In the controlled validation, MARRR was preferred overall to fixed rates from the prior approach, with consistently significant preference for predictable user-induced motion and selection probability above 70%. In the game validation, MARRR was also preferred overall to fixed-refresh rendering.
overview: This evidence connects the perceptual model to practical rendering control. It shows that optimizing resolution and refresh rate from measured motion can improve viewer preference, although unpredictable-motion and high-refresh comparisons remained noisier because of display synchronization limits.
title: MARRR Preference Validation
